pages.text: Where the Sandglass counts days, the Sundial tells the hours of one.

Set it under open sky. Its copper gnomon throws a shadow across the hour lines, and a $(item)comparator$() reads it: nothing all night, rising through the morning to full strength at $(thing)noon$(), and falling again to sunset.$(br2)Roofed over, or in a world with no sun, no shadow falls and it reads nothing. Click it to ask what it says.
